mechanism: The exported C-API functions take a Rust `&str` (a pointer/length pair passed in two registers) where the C prototype has `const char *`. A C caller's (path, uid, gid) is received as path.ptr = path, path.len = uid, uid = gid, gid = an unset register. fs_chown then builds a CString from `uid` bytes starting at path. Depending on the bytes past the string, it panics in CString::new (interior NUL; a panic inside extern "C" aborts) or faults reading unmapped memory. The C returns chown()'s result, -1 for our paths.
